name: AR_RECEIPT_METHODS
description: The AR_RECEIPT_METHODS table contains information about receipt methods, which are receipt attributes that you define and assign to receipt classes to account for receipts and their applications. For automatically created receipts, a receipt method defines the rules for creating these receipts. For manually created receipts, a receipt method defines a user-definable receipt type. Each receipt method is associated with a set of bank accounts, which forms the set of bank accounts that can be assigned to a receipt. For example, if you normally receive Lockbox transmissions from more than one bank, you might create a Lockbox payment method and assign bank accounts from each of those banks to this payment method. The primary key for this table is RECEIPT_METHOD_ID.

columns.name: LEAD_DAYS

columns.name: MATURITY_DATE_RULE_CODE

columns.name: RECEIPT_CREATION_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the rule that is used to group automatic receipts that this receipt method creates. For example, one per customer or one per site.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment type for this payment method, values include CASH, CHECK, and CREDIT CARD

columns.name: MERCHANT_ID
columns.description: Merchant's identifier for the Credit Card Processor, usually provided by the bank or credit card issuer

columns.name: RECEIPT_INHERIT_INV_NUM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a receipt that the Automatic Receipts program creates is assigned the same document number as the transaction that the receipt pays

columns.name: DM_INHERIT_RECEIPT_NUM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the debit memo that a debit memo reversal creates is assigned the same document number as the reversed receipt

columns.name: BR_CUST_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bills receivable transaction type used to create a bill receivable in a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: BR_MIN_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Smallest amount necessary to create a bill receivable from applied transactions for a given receipt method.

columns.name: BR_MAX_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Largest amount possible for a bill receivable created from applied transactions for a given receipt method.

columns.name: BR_INHERIT_INV_NUM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the bill receivable receives the same transaction number as the transaction to which it is applied.

columns.name: MERCHANT_REF
columns.description: Merchant's identifier for the Credit Card Processor, usually provided by the bank or credit card issuer

columns.name: PAYMENT_CHANNEL_CODE
columns.description: Identifies payment channel

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ISO20022_DIRECT_DEBIT_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether a receipt method is used for ISO20022 direct debit collections. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ADVANCED_FUND_TRANSFER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether advanced fund transfer error handling is enabled on the receipt method.
